read.text: The ledger names two separate claims: Seris’s delegated patron bond and the archlord’s superior lien. Cancelling only the first transfers collection to the second. A dispute supported by testimony can suspend collection without cancelling either claim. Another page records Mara’s soul among those Seris collected.

choices.text: Preserve Mara’s testimony and disclose all clauses to Rowan.
Read the clauses; leave Mara’s testimony for now.

preserve.text: You copy the clauses and Mara’s testimony into the public record. Her soul remains captive; the record gives the rescuers a name and a destination. Rowan receives his own copy.

clauses.text: You record the two claims. The registrar will still need evidence of abuse before she can issue a stay.
